name: MIKEY

traits.Hair: Slicked-back black hair with taper fade
traits.Top: Open black-and-white buffalo-check flannel over white tee

bio: The unofficial mayor of the block. Slicked hair, flannel open, thumbs in his pockets like he already knows how it ends. Mikey never raises his voice because he's never had to. When something needs sorting out, everybody says his name first.

name: RICO

traits.Top: Olive button-up shirt over white tee

bio: Rico says little, and when he talks, the block listens. Du-rag tight, arms crossed, posted where he can see the whole street. He walks the younger kids home without being asked. If Rico's got your back, you're covered.
knownFor: the stare, Timbs without a scuff.

name: LOLA

traits.Hair: Sleek low bun with baby edges
traits.Top: Cropped pink moto jacket over black top

bio: Edges laid, hoops on, comeback loaded. Lola runs the group chat, plans every link-up, and never forgets a birthday. Pink moto jacket, hand on hip, zero patience for nonsense. Cross one of her people and she remembers.
knownFor: the winged liner, the side-eye, being right.

name: JACE

traits.Top: Navy snap-front jacket with white chest panel

bio: Fresh cornrows every Sunday, no exceptions. Jace stays still while everything around him moves. He's stacking every dollar from his weekend job toward a plan he hasn't told anyone. The silver ID bracelet was his grandpa's, and it never comes off.
knownFor: the brow slit, quiet plans, keeping it a hundred.

name: DEE

traits.Pose: Hand on chest, hand in pocket

bio: Dee skated onto the block two summers ago and never left. Sandy mop, big tee, shorts in any weather. He talks to strangers like old friends, and somehow it works. When the crew ends up at the beach on a Tuesday, it's Dee's fault.
knownFor: curb kickflips, the ears, zero bad days.

name: NOVA
bio: Purple velour, Caesar lined up sharp, hands folded. Nova clocks everything and says only what matters. Smartest one in the room, and she lets you figure that out yourself. Old-school taste, new-school mind.
knownFor: the velour set, winning arguments quietly.

name: BOOGIE
bio: Born to move. High-top fade, shell-toes, a royal blue track jacket that has seen a hundred dance circles. Any beat, any corner, he's already in it. He swears the goatee makes him look grown.

name: KEI

traits.Top: Teal zip hoodie over white tee

bio: Kei has fixed half the phones on the block and won't take a dollar for it. Bowl cut, square frames, teal hoodie zipped to the same spot every day. Arms crossed because he's thinking, not mad. If it has wires, Kei can make it better.
knownFor: the frames, orange kicks, jokes that land late.

name: TRINA
bio: First on the court, last off it. Headband on, jersey cropped, arms folded after every bucket. Trina's jumper has humbled a lot of people who thought they could hoop. She competes at everything, even the walk to the store.
knownFor: fox eyes, freckles, never losing twice.

name: MARV
bio: Marv always looks like he just woke up, because he did. All olive, beanie low, hands in the hoodie pocket. He's up all night making beats on a laptop with a cracked screen. The tired eyes are earned.

name: SKYE
bio: Skye taped her wrists for skating once and never stopped. Auburn coils, black tee, shoes worn down to the grip. She rubs the back of her neck while she reads you. Not shy, just picky about who gets the real her.
knownFor: the wrist tape, landing it first try.

name: GIO
bio: Gio hears the world through his headphones and only takes them off for people who matter. Freeform locs, charcoal zip-up, a brow ring he fought to get. He knows the song before it blows up. Ask him for a playlist and get one for every mood.
knownFor: the cans, the brow ring, early ears.

name: SUNNY
bio: Yellow hoodie, one beaded braid, a nameplate chain so nobody forgets who walked in. Sunny makes bracelets by hand and has customers three streets over. Hand on hip, deal closed. She can turn anyone's bad day around.
knownFor: the nameplate, the beads, the hustle.

name: TANK

traits.Hair: Low skin fade with full beard

bio: The biggest homee on the block, and the gentlest. Beard came in early, sleeveless hoodie in every season, arms crossed like a wall. Little kids climb him like a jungle gym. Nothing starts when Tank's around, and that's how he likes it.
knownFor: the thick rope chain, the softest heart.

name: VEE
bio: Hood up, hands in the pocket, maybe four words a day. Vee shows up everywhere, sees everything, and is gone before the streetlights. Word is there's a sketchbook with a drawing of everyone on the block. Nobody has seen it.

name: BLAZE

traits.Top: Fire red bomber jacket over white tee

bio: Red bomber, red work boots, fitted cap low. Blaze doesn't do quiet colors. He keeps the mustache groomed like it's a full beard, and he's always got a plan and a car he's going to buy. Loud, loyal, impossible to miss.

name: MELLO

traits.Top: Slate blue open-collar shirt over white tee

bio: Mellow by name and nature. Rounded afro, open collar, slacks pressed like he's got an interview, because he usually does. Every auntie on the block compliments the freckles. He keeps the peace without trying.
knownFor: the afro, the calmest voice in the room.

name: ZION
bio: Zion is the one the HOMEEZ trust with the plan. Close-cut coils, forest green crewneck, hand on his chest when he gives his word, and he keeps it. Good grades he never brags about, and a little brother he never loses sight of. The last figure in the series, holding it all together.
knownFor: keeping promises, big brother to everyone.
